title: Orientation
description: auto lays the readouts out in one row when the source is wider than 1.6:1 and stacks them otherwise; the others force one arrangement. Size the source to suit (default 840×96 in a row, about 320×300 stacked).

title: Alignment
description: Which edge of the source the card hugs when the source is larger than the card. Stacked: right also puts UR on the right edge.

title: Motion
description: full = on the results screen the card rises in, the histogram's bars grow from the zero line and the numbers settle, once. reduced = the card still fades in and out; no bar growth or settling. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Corner marks
description: The 18-LAB registration marks on the box's top-left and bottom-right corners. neutral = warm white. amber = both in 18-LAB amber. tl = amber, top-left only. none = no marks.

title: Show hit-error histogram
description: Timing histogram and the early/late split. UR and mean stay when it is off. osu!catch has no timing, so only the if-FC gap shows there.

title: pp
description: The pp a full combo would have added (the same if-FC value as pp-counter), shown only when combo was lost. Neither results screen shows it.

title: Hold duration / s
description: Seconds it stays up after the results screen opens. 0 keeps it up for as long as the results screen is open.
